# External reach + safe mode — status: live verification pass (stage E done)

Session of 2026-11-08. The verification checklist in `003` §4, run against a live Paperless the platform didn't start. All four "Done when" boxes are met. Two bugs found by the live pass are fixed (§2). Nothing committed yet (commit plan: `004` §5).

## 1. Setup

- `~/paperless-external` was gone (no compose file, containers or volumes; only the image). I recreated it by hand, outside the platform (`001` E6): `compose.yml` with `redis:7` + `ghcr.io/paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx:3.4.2`, `127.0.0.1:8010`, admin `admin` / `change-me`, fresh volumes. Started with `docker compose up -d`.
- Token from `POST /api/token/`, stored with `uv run tp target secret paperless-external token=<token>`.
- Two hand-made tags, `hand-a` and `hand-b`, so I could check that a run doesn't touch other people's data.

## 2. Bugs found and fixed

| # | Found by | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | r-0033 (report stage failed, `KeyError: 'build'`) | `ExternalStack.fingerprint()["network"]` had only `run`. The report renders `network['run']` and `network['build']` (`tp/stages/report/render.py`), and the container path always has both | `build: "none: the system was already running"` (`tp/stages/env/blackbox.py`). Regression assert in `test_external.py`: `{"run", "build"} <= network` |
| 2 | r-0036 (live discovery asked "Add two items to any collection by hand" though `/api/tags/` held two) | `LiveDiscovery.step_data` kept the repo path's `max_resources: 3` cap (`config/discovery.yaml`). That cap exists because each repo-path try creates items. Live discovery only reads, and the tags are the 11th collection | No cap in `LiveDiscovery.step_data`; the repo path (`Discovery.step_data`) keeps it. Regression: the live test sets `max_resources` to 0 and still passes (it fails without the fix) |

## 3. Evidence for each "Done when" box

**Paperless onboards as an external system (URL + token), same pipeline.**
```
$ caffeinate -i uv run tp run --unattended --target paperless-external --brief "Paperless tags: …"
r-0034  succeeded  mode=live
  input, spec, cases, generate, gate, env, execute, triage, report, retest: all succeeded
P0 defects: 0 · P1 0 · P2 0 · P3 spec/code drift: 5
Generic checks: 35 case(s); server/spec disagree on 3
```

**The report ceiling says "seen on the live system" and differs from the container run.**
```
data/runs/report-exec-242/summary.md: Strongest claim: Seen on the live system, stable 3/3.
                                      Network: at run time runner on an internal network, out only
                                      through the safe-mode proxy; build: none: the system was already running.
data/runs/report-exec-222/summary.md (container): Strongest claim: Stable, property-checked.
```

**Every blocked op is listed as `NOT_RUN: safe mode`.** Excluded (NOT_RUN) 14/35 in r-0034. Reasons seen in the gate's junit:
- `deny category 'group'`: POST /api/groups/
- `deny category 'mail'`: POST /api/mail_accounts/
- `create body doesn't carry the run prefix`: POST /api/correspondents/, /api/custom_fields/, /api/document_types/ (invalid-input bodies)
- `not created by this run`: PUT/PATCH /api/correspondents/<id not ours>/
- `property checks run reads only`: Schemathesis on POST

The fake-target "no unsafe request leaves" half was already met in `002` (`test_rt_proxy.py`).

**Zero leftovers after the run, and after a cancelled run.**
- After r-0034: `uv run tp target clean paperless-external` → `deleted 0 · failed 0 · unknown_delete_route 0 · deleted_by_test 0`. The ledger has 0 lines. Read-only listing of tags, correspondents, custom_fields, document_types, storage_paths, groups and mail_accounts: only `['hand-a', 'hand-b']`, no `tp-` names.
- Cancelled run r-0035: `POST /runs/35/cancel` while the gate's proxy batch was in flight → `cancelled`. The in-flight gate finished (a cancel takes effect between stages, `002` §3) and env…retest never ran. Afterwards: same listing, ledger 0 lines, `clean` deleted 0, no proxy container left.
- Each gate batch (k0, k1, k2, shuffled, in r-0034 and r-0035) recorded `deleted_by_test: 6`, so real creates did go through the proxy and were deleted.

**Live discovery (`001` E9 step 3).**
```
$ uv run tp target add http://localhost:8010 --live --secret token=<token>
r-0036  awaiting_review   setup 385: Add two items to any collection by hand …   ← bug 2
(fixed) $ uv run tp review resolve 385 answer --text done
r-0036  succeeded   #255 discover succeeded
$ uv run tp target show localhost-8010
reach {strategy: external, url: http://localhost:8010, health: /api/schema/}
auth  {strategy: token_header, scheme: Token, check: /api/config/, token: {secret: token}}
data  {id_field: id, id_style: integer, paging: {style: page, page: page, size: page_size}}
safety {strategy: safe_mode}
```
`data/targets/localhost-8010/probes.json`: 18 probes, all GET. The ID field came from `GET /api/tags/1/` (probe 15) and paging from probes 16 and 17.

**Suite after both fixes:** `uv run pytest -q -m "not docker"` → **391 passed**. `ruff check`, `ruff format --check` and `tp check-folders` (rc 0) pass.

## 4. Not covered, and things noticed

- Cleanup's own DELETE path (`deleted > 0`) wasn't exercised live: the tests deleted everything themselves. It is unit-tested (`test_external.py`).
- HTTPS to a remote upstream: not exercised (single machine, `001` E6).
- r-0034's 3 "server and spec disagree" rows: Paperless answers 404 to some Schemathesis list reads, and its spec doesn't document a 404. That's a live finding, not a platform bug.
- The brief's tag criteria (C-1 to C-4) got no authored cases in the unattended run; the generic checks cover the first five collections, which are not tags. I didn't look into why. Raise it in F or G if it matters for the demo.
